name: data_completeness
label: Data completeness (demand, %)
description: Share of expected BA-hours that have a reported demand value, as a fraction from 0 to 1. Expected hours run from each BA's first report to the latest hour with demand. Synonyms: coverage, missing data, gaps.

name: demand
label: Demand (MWh)
description: Total electricity demand (load) in MWh: the sum of hourly demand over the selected hours and balancing authorities. Hours the BA did not report are excluded. Synonyms: load, consumption, usage.

name: demand_month_to_date
label: Demand, month to date (MWh)
description: Cumulative demand from the start of each month.

name: forecast_bias
label: Day-ahead forecast bias (MWh)
description: Average of (forecast - actual) demand per hour, over hours where both were reported. Positive means the operator over-forecast; negative means it under-forecast.

name: forecast_error_mape
label: Day-ahead forecast error (MAPE, %)
description: Mean absolute percentage error of the BA's day-ahead demand forecast: average of |actual - forecast| / actual x 100 over hours where actual demand > 0 and both values were reported. Lower is better.

name: peak_demand
label: Peak hourly demand (MW)
description: Highest single-hour demand of one balancing authority in the period (MWh in one hour = average MW). NOT a system peak: when grouped across several BAs it returns the largest individual BA-hour, not the combined peak. For a region's combined peak use coincident_peak_demand (added later).
